meta.note: Source of truth for the Downloads section. Going live is a data change, not an HTML edit: set an entry's status to "available" and fill in version, url, sha256 and size. js/site.js renders this into every [data-downloads] block; the static HTML in index.html is the no-JavaScript fallback and must say the same thing.
